Perform GRN Inference

Source: R/bulkPanel_GRNFuns.R
infer_GRN.Rd

Performs Metabolite Peak Regulatory Network inference on a subset of the intensity matrix for a set of target metabolite peaks of interest.

Usage

infer_GRN(
  intensity_matrix,
  metadata,
  anno,
  seed = 13,
  targets,
  condition,
  samples,
  inference_method
)

Arguments

intensity_matrix

Numeric matrix of peak intensities with peaks as rows and samples as columns.

metadata

Data frame with sample metadata; rows must match ncol(intensity_matrix).

anno

Data frame with peak annotation including 'display_name' (peak names) and 'm_z' (peak IDs).

seed

Numeric seed for reproducibility (default: 13).

targets

Character vector of target metabolite peak names/IDs to focus GRN on.

condition

Character name of metadata column to subset samples by.

samples

Character vector of condition values to include in analysis.

inference_method

Character specifying GRN method; currently only "GENIE3" is supported.

Value

Adjacency matrix with regulators in rows, targets in columns. Values represent edge weights from GENIE3 algorithm.

Details

When sample count exceeds 1000, a random subset of 1000 samples is used for computational efficiency. The random seed is set for reproducibility.
